video_title: Jorge Sedano Reacts "Could the Lakers land Jalen Duran & Peyton Watson?"

quotes.speaker: Jorge Sedano
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers potential pursuit of Jalen Duren and Peyton Watson
quotes.excerpt: I think Jalen Duren has more upside than Peyton Watson.

text_blocks.speaker: Scott Kapla
text_blocks.text: Of the people that you are talking about here, Jalen Duren, Peyton Watson, if you are getting two of these, which two of these would you think would be the best that could actually fit? Would like Jalen Duren and Peyton Watson be your best overall? If you are going to go to LeBron and Anthony Davis to take less money, which two?

text_blocks.speaker: Jorge Sedano
text_blocks.text: If you are telling me they can afford them both, I think Jalen Duren has more upside than Peyton Watson. I think Peyton Watson is just okay offensively. He can be limited. I think Jalen Duren, despite his challenges this postseason, people forget, Jalen Duren is only 22 years old. He has so much growth to do professionally, emotionally, mentally, skill-wise. To me, he has a much higher ceiling than Peyton Watson.

quotes.speaker: Jorge Sedano
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers interest in retaining Marcus Smart and Luke Kennard
quotes.excerpt: The Lakers are interested in retaining Marcus Smart and sharp shooter Luke Kennard.
quotes.quote: The Lakers are interested in retaining Marcus Smart and sharp shooter Luke Kennard. They believe that Rui Hachimura is probably gone. Not saying that it is a definitive, but they believe that Hachimura could be the odd man out and he could end up somewhere else.

quotes.speaker: Jorge Sedano
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Peyton Watson and Rui Hachimura as players
quotes.excerpt: Peyton Watson is a more well-rounded player while I don't believe he's as good a shooter as Rui.

text_blocks.speaker: Jorge Sedano
text_blocks.text: Peyton Watson is a more well-rounded player while I don't believe he's as good a shooter as Rui Hachimura. Peyton Watson is a better defender. I think he has more wiggle room to his offensive game than Rui has.

text_blocks.speaker: Scott Kapla
text_blocks.text: Peyton Watson is also, just as we are talking about Jalen Duren, this is a kid who is 23 years old and was also drafted in 2022. But by the way, Peyton Watson is a good three-point shooter, turned into one, let's call it that. But he is younger and so when I keep saying to you it is a young man's game, look at how the Knicks are kind of all in their late 20s and in their primes.

quotes.speaker: Jorge Sedano
quotes.summary_phrase: Building a competitive Lakers roster with LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: You can build a team with LeBron on it that has younger, athletic players.
quotes.quote: You can build a team with LeBron James on it that has younger, athletic players who are veterans, who can continue to grow and have room to grow and have not hit their ceiling. You build a team that can win with LeBron, Austin Reaves, and Luka Doncic, and a team that is also still on the path to winning when LeBron is gone. You can do that. You have to thread a needle, but it is possible.
